subject: Everline MAP: technical runway, milestones & owner commitments
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kaur <samir.kaur@everline.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@everline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Everline MAP: technical runway, milestones & owner commitments

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for the kickoff today. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Everline_MAP_v1.xlsx) that translates the items we discussed into a 10-week runway toward pilot go-live. High level notes up front: 

- Objective: pilot serving 3 use-cases (search re-ranking, customer Q&A, and assisted write) with SLOs defined per-case.
- Timeline: 10 weeks with a staged cutover (alpha -> beta -> pilot).
- Critical path: (1) data ingestion & privacy review, (2) model selection & tuning, (3) integration and acceptance testing, (4) rollout monitoring.

Please review the owner column — I assigned tentative internal owners for each milestone, and flagged two items that need Everline input: 1) data access approval (security contact), 2) production traffic acceptance criteria. If you prefer different owners on our side, call it out and we’ll update.

Key milestones in the sheet (high level):
- Week 1 (May 31 - Jun 6): Data scope finalization, data access plan, security questionnaire due.
- Week 3 (Jun 14): Initial model onboarding & benchmark reports.
- Week 6 (Jul 5): Integration smoke tests and latency checks.
- Week 9 (Jul 26): Pilot acceptance window opens.
- Week 10 (Aug 2): Pilot go-live (limited traffic).

Ask: can you confirm the Everline security contact for data access and confirm decision authority for pilot acceptance by EOD Tuesday (Jun 1)?

Attachments: Everline_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP), Everline_technical_runway.pdf (one-pager).

Thanks — I’ll schedule a 30-min checkpoint next week to lock owners.

—
Jasmine Liu

> 
> Thanks again for the kickoff today. As promised, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (Everline_MAP_v1.xlsx) ...

Thanks Jasmine — this looks like a useful starting point. A few quick items from our side: 

- Security contact: That will be Priya Shah (cc’d). She’ll own the data access & SOC-related items.
- Pilot acceptance: final sign-off will come from me + our Product lead (we’ll confirm name this week).
- Timeline: overall OK but can we shift the model onboarding benchmarks to Week 2 (earlier) — our infra team is ready to help this week and it speeds up tuning.

Also, can Ben / your engineering lead include a short list of what instrumentation Redwood needs for observability (metrics/logs/traces) so our SRE can pre-provision?

I’m available for a 30-min sync next Wed 2026-06-03 10:00-10:30 PT — does that work for the Redwood team?

Regards,

On Fri, May 28, 2026 at 11:03 AM Samir Kaur <samir.kaur@everline.com> wrote:
> Thanks Jasmine — this looks like a useful starting point. A few quick items from our side: ...

Thanks Samir — I can take point on the observability/instrumentation items. Short answer up front: we’ll need request-level tracing (correlation id), per-route latency histograms, token-level cost counters, and error rates per model variant. I’ll put a one-page observability requirements doc in Drive by EOD today.

Regarding the timeline tweak — shifting model onboarding to Week 2 works for us if Everline infra can provide the sample dataset and access this week (per Jasmine’s sheet). Monica will lead the data ingestion work on our side; Laura will coordinate acceptance criteria and run the pilot playbook.

Committed internal owners: 
- Data ingestion & privacy gating: Monica Patel
- Model tuning & benchmarks: Ben Carter (with engineering support)
- Integration & QA runbook: Laura Bennett
- Post-go-live monitoring & escalations: Jasmine Liu

I’ll add a column to the MAP spreadsheet for escalation paths and expected SLAs.

—

Subject: Everline MAP: updated run-of-play and invite for 2026-06-03

Thanks all — updated the MAP with the owner column, observability checklist, and a revised week mapping (moved model onboarding into Week 2). New file: Everline_MAP_v1.1.xlsx attached (sheet "Owners & Risks").

I’ve scheduled the 30-minute sync for 2026-06-03 10:00 PT (Google Meet link in calendar invite). Agenda:
1) Confirm Everline security contact & data access timeline (Priya)
2) Model onboarding checklist and sample data handoff (Monica + Everline infra)
3) Observability/instrumentation requirements (Ben)
4) Pilot acceptance criteria & sign-off process (Samir)

Quick risks called out in the sheet: 
- If data access is delayed > 5 business days, model tuning will slip 2 weeks.
- Network peering/account limits may require Dedicated capacity config — we’ll surface any quota needs prior to integration.

Attachments: Everline_MAP_v1.1.xlsx (updated), Everline_technical_runway.pdf (unchanged).

If anything urgent before the sync, reply-all and Ben/Monica will triage. Looking forward to locking dates.
